title: Services
metaDescription: Four divisions: civil and infrastructure, water resources, electrical and mechanical, and energy. Each draws on Sato's shared project management, equipment fleet and HSE systems.

body: Four divisions, one standard of delivery. Each division draws on Sato's shared project management, equipment fleet and HSE systems.

sections.heading: Backed by Sato
sections.intro: Whichever division delivers your project, the same plant, people and systems stand behind it.

items.label: Equipment and capabilities
items.body: Sato owns and operates its own plant and equipment, which lets us mobilise quickly and control quality and schedule on site.

items.label: Health, safety, environment and quality
items.body: Sato operates its own safety management system. It is implemented on every project and audited internally every three months.

sections.body: Working on a project in civil, water or energy infrastructure? Talk to our team.

sections.heading: For procurement and vendor verification
sections.body: If you are registering Sato as a vendor or assessing us for an oil and gas tender, contact our head office for company documentation, registrations and project references.
